decisions.reason: Submarine interior lighting is a niche defense product with long naval program cycles and service obligations, so a large lighting firm is unlikely to withdraw it quickly.
Explosion-proof industrial luminaires are a certified, durable B2B line that the firm actively extended with LED retrofit kits, which signals ongoing commitment.
The relaunched designer task light builds on a popular established design with its own product page, though design lines face some portfolio pruning risk.
Pendant office luminaires are core commercial lighting products with steady demand from office refurbishment, despite post-pandemic office uncertainty.
The premium pendant luminaire is recent and fits the firm's architectural lighting range, so dropping it within a year is unlikely, though premium lines are reviewed more often.
